name: Planeswalking
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 14th; Price +68,650 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

A suit of planeswalking armor constantly shifts between a multitude of designs and colors while twinkling stars blink in and out of view. While in this armor, the wearer is immune to the harmful effects of any plane of existence that is not the wearer’s native plane, functioning as planar adaptation. In addition, once per day the wearer can command the armor to transport it to a different plane of existence, as plane shift.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells planar adaptation, plane shift; Cost +3 bonus.
